lines.text: Many learners say: Please turn on the beamer.
Better: Please turn on the projector.
A projector shows pictures on a wall.
Projector! Please turn on the projector.

data.why: A projector shows pictures on a wall.

native.tip: Im Englischen heißt der Beamer „projector“. „Beamer“ kennt dort kaum jemand.

en.hook: Are you in a meeting and need the Beamer?
en.tip: In English a Beamer is a “projector”. Hardly anyone knows “beamer”.
en.caption: Are you in a meeting and need the Beamer? Wrong: “Please turn on the beamer.” Right: “Please turn on the projector.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
